venue: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium, Gainesville FL
title: Week 1 vs FAU
dek: Baugh was the best player on the field. Faulkner would not let FAU play him one way.
watchNote: PROVISIONAL — stop when the idea lands. Fan rail stays empty until Charles approves.
headline: You cannot put a card on this offense.

offense.body:
You cannot put a card on this offense. That is the point.

Faulkner does not install a system you can memorize. He asks a new question before you finish the last one. Same start. Different answer. Backside still live.

Creep up for Baugh and he throws the short one to Brown. First man misses. Brown scores from 49 yards. Long touchdown, short throw.

Follow the tackles who look like they are leading a run and the ball goes the other way. Brown. Three linemen already out in front. Later Clark. Same picture. On his touchdown those big people are already down the field.

Stay put and play Baugh and he runs it. Scores from 12 with those linemen actually leading him. Third quarter, everybody knows, and he still rips off 61 yards.

You never catch up to the last one. Baugh is already the next one.

Fourteen carries, 160 yards, three rushing scores. FAU filled every hole on some plays and he still ripped it. Faulkner’s job is to keep you from putting eleven on him. Clark is how they stay off thirty carries.

When they finally put extra men on Baugh, someone is alone. Wilson sits where you leave him. Stockton walked in from the 11. Abrams over the top for 63 yards.

Philo ran the offense. The pick is Mays. Ball off his hands. Sweeney sitting. When Philo holds it, the play dies. The snaps over his head are Moore. The one that lost twenty yards inside the five is the kind that loses real games.

Philo ran it himself once. FAU’s end still there. Lost two yards. Idea fine. Play lost.

They block down the field like they mean it. Micah Jones blows up one man, then the next, and they throw him the last touchdown.
bullets: Creep up for Baugh and Brown scores from 49.
Follow the fake and the ball goes the other way.
Stay put and Baugh rips off 61 when everybody knew.

defense.body:
FAU wants the short throw until you take it away. Florida never took it away. Henry and Valsin lived on the five-to-eight. Ninety plays. Ten of thirteen on third down. Sumrall said it. Third-and-1, you cannot have your corner nine yards off. That happened.

White will not let a tackle get comfortable. Woods is how. One snap he is coming from the outside. The next he walks inside and someone else has that edge. Same down. Different rush.

When Veltkamp holds it, Coleman sells the middle. Veltkamp thinks the outside is one-on-one. It is not. Coleman shoots back outside, over the top of Valsin, and intercepts it at Florida’s 5. He tips the next one. Johnson goes up and gets it. Bett beats the quarterback at the 1. Ball out. Johnson falls on it. McCloud wins fourth-and-2.

The pile at the 1. They had enough people. They lost the yard. The man on the outside left and Veltkamp walked in from 7. Clark lost one to the corner of the end zone. Valsin scored from 20.
bullets: The short throw stayed open. Ninety plays.
White moves Woods so the tackle never settles.
Coleman sells the middle, then intercepts it at Florida’s 5.

specials.body: Durkin from 53. Clean. Florida never punts. FAU’s 18-yard punt starts Florida’s second score.
bullets: FAU’s 18-yard punt starts Florida’s second score.

nextWeek.look: They will throw it short and the quarterback will run it. Sixkiller is their guy. Hand it to Baugh. Ask a new question. Stand on the short throw. Keep Woods on the outside when Sixkiller runs it.
